statements.status_notes: PostgreSQL upstream lists this vulnerability as affecting only major version 18 before 18.7; versions before PostgreSQL 18 are unaffected (https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-120144/). Debian marks postgresql-17 as not affected because the vulnerable code was introduced in PostgreSQL 18 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-120144).

PostgreSQL upstream lists this vulnerability as affecting only major version 18 before 18.7; versions before PostgreSQL 18 are unaffected (https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116329/). Debian marks postgresql-17 as not affected because the vulnerable code was introduced in PostgreSQL 18 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-116329). The statistics import functions (pg_restore_attribute_stats, pg_clear_attribute_stats) that this vulnerability is in are not present in PostgreSQL 17.
